Make the entire file a seamless repeat with constant ambience or musical continuity at the join; no audible restart, baked fade, extra reverb tail or added silence. No intelligible words, dialogue sentences, music, background ambience or unrelated actions. Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target. Exact whole-file cyclic edit; no head/tail fades or padded silence baked into the loop. Wrap reverb/noise decay across seam.
